pendingAssignment.reason: Core logging sink, but io/DwgIo.cpp and io/LibreDwgCad.cpp include util/SaveTrace.hpp as a private header. Assigning it to Core now would add two private-header violations. The move ticket must add GoSurvey/Core/SaveTrace.hpp, switch the two includes, then map the files to Core. The file is temporary diagnostics for issue #167, so deleting it is also an option.

outsideScan: internal/core/CorePrivate.hpp: private header for Core.cpp. It is outside src/, so the ratchet does not scan it. Move it with Core.

settings (to add): typed display-precision and angle-display values, replacing raw ints on AppCommandState
logging (to add): none yet; a logging facade is a homeless concept (see auditFindings)
internal, not public: anglefmt_detail::Normalize360, FormatDms, FormatDecimalDeg (exposed in AngleFormat.hpp today)

tests/LibreDwgCadTests.cpp (AUNITS through DWG header output, line 5142)
testGaps: no decision yet on whether users accept Core zero-padded DMS output in place of the legacy unpadded form before the legacy formatters are retired

homelessConcepts: Logging facade: none. Sinks are scattered: EditorWindow::m_Log (command line, Qt), SaveTrace (Core), UpdateService LogSilently (Network), StartupFailure startup-failure.log (Windows), and Qt qWarning/qDebug calls in src/qt. The final map must decide whether Core owns one facade or only the file sink.
Settings store: AppCommandState holds nearly all settings in one god struct. There is no Settings system. Core owns the value vocabulary; the holder and its consumers belong to the final map.
Duration and ETA text: FormatEtaRemaining is pure formatting used only by a progress UI. Core or UI?
Lat/long DMS label: FormatLatLongLabel and CadCommands_Geo FormatDms. Geo or Core formatting?
Plot-scale labels: PlotScaleChoicesFor and PlotScaleLabel (util/PlotScales.hpp) are Document or Plot, not Core.
Station text: FormatStation (Alignment) belongs to Alignment, not Core.
couplings: Foot/meter conversion constants are duplicated in several systems: geo/DrawingConversion.cpp, io/LandXmlIo.cpp, pdf/PdfMeasure.cpp, traverse/JobXmlImport.cpp, traverse/TraverseCalc.cpp, traverse/TraverseLeastSquares.cpp (kMetersToFeet), traverse/StarNetImport.cpp. Core units should own them.

Local trim/lower/upper/prefix/compare helpers outside src/core: 42 definitions or declarations, each a sections entry with concern strings (for example io/DxfIo.cpp Trim, io/WikiHelp.cpp ToLowerAscii, traverse/StarNetImport.cpp TrimCopy, ui/CommandBar.hpp TrimAscii). StringUtil exists but only 9 files include it.

CadFormatBearingCwNorthDegMinSec and CadFormatAngleDegMinSecFromRad in CadCommands.cpp are divergent from Core FormatBearing and FormatSweptAngle: unpadded minutes, and a 359-degree cap in the swept-angle form. AngleFormat.hpp says FormatBearing reproduces the bearing formatter at default settings; that comment is false and stale.
AppCommandState stores angle display as raw ints (angleDisplayType). CadAngleDisplaySettings (Commands) converts them to the typed Core AngleDisplaySettings on every call.
DrawingSettings (Document, per-drawing) embeds the AngularUnits and FootDefinition enums that Core units should own.
io/UserPrefs.cpp reads and writes AppCommandState settings fields directly, so the IO system depends on Commands state.
SaveTrace (Core) calls Win32 GetTempPathW and DeleteFileW directly. Core must not own platform APIs, so the path lookup belongs to the Windows system or should be injected.
SaveTrace is called from io/DwgIo.cpp and io/LibreDwgCad.cpp. It is temporary diagnostics for issue #167 and can be deleted when that issue closes.
misMappedFolders: mappedFolders src/font/ -> Core is wrong. src/font holds the SHX file loader (ShxFont.*: file format, IO) and font-name classification (CadFontName.hpp: Renderer or Document). Not changed in this PR; the final-map ticket should reassign it. ADR-022 calls it a 'shared lower layer', which the final map must reconcile.
namespaceGaps: ADR-0006 requires GoSurvey::<System> namespaces. NumFormat and AngleFormat use the global namespace (anglefmt_detail is global). StringUtil is namespace StringUtil. Core.cpp's detail is GoSurvey::Core::detail. Namespace work follows the move, not this audit.
notCoreDespiteName: src/util/framewatch.hpp and src/util/docinvariants.*: Debug (diagnostics), not logging.
